_doc: Every visual/audio asset the MATCHER and COSMIC SPUD games wear, where it came from, its license, and how to re-fetch or re-derive it. Re-derive: python3 tools/v033p3_art.py + python3 tools/v033p3_sfx.py (patch 3 re-derives the p1/p2 set too). All sources CC0 or the owner's own upload. COSMIC SPUD (v0.3.4) re-derive: python3 tools/v034_cs_art.py + python3 tools/v034_cs_audio.py (the raw hunt cache lives outside the repo; the manifest lines below carry the sources).

Nothing from either APK is committed or shipped.

assets/games/cosmic_spud.provenance: v0.3.4-1 THE ART REBIRTH: every sprite regenerated by tools/v034p1_art.py (the repo's own generator, CC0 - our own pixels). The shading engine: silhouette -> gradient base -> light/shadow bands -> dark outline -> rim light; 4x supersampled. | v0.3.8-3 THE ROSTER FACES: assets/games/cosmic_spud/allies/ally_{drone,turret,guard,medic,bomber,scout}.png drawn by tools/v038p3_allies.py (the six potato crew faces in the hero art's style - the owner's 'all allies look the same' report; re-derive: python3 tools/v038p3_allies.py). | v0.3.8-4 THE ALIVE CREW: the six allies REDRAWN as 4-frame walk cycles (ally_<id>_f0..f3.png + the compat portraits) by tools/v038p4_allies.py - the potato bodies wear the hero's own recipe (lumpy silhouette, glow, outline, big eyes, boots) with role gear (rotor beanie drone, hard-hat turret with cannon, steel-shield guard, red-cross medic, fuse-bomb bomber, capped scout with a dart); the field animation (_ally_theater) drives the frames, the left-right flip and the squash like the enemies' own walk (the owner's 'static image' report).
assets/games/cosmic_spud.notes: spudnik.png deleted (the 6 hero_<start>_f<k>.png walk sets replaced it). The cosmic coin (pickups/coin.png) is a NEW design: a gold coin with a potato embossed in the middle - deliberately NOT the box's gogacoin (assets/ui/coin.png).

assets/games/geometry.provenance: v0.3.6 GEOMETRY FLASH: 100% original neon-filled redesigns by tools/v036_gf_art.py (study-informed anatomy per docs/goga_docs/gogames_ideas/geometry.md + docs/DECOMPILATION.md). Re-derive: python3 tools/v036_gf_art.py && python3 tools/v036_gf_sfx.py. The owner's laws live in the game header (game/games/geometry/geometry.gd). | v0.3.6-1: the p1 pass is 100% original too - tools/v036p1_gf_art.py (the p_soft/p_streak/p_puff/p_star particle vocabulary, the shield_core mark, the pow_* capsule icons, and the re-filled block/line/strip/pusher surfaces) + tools/v036p1_gf_sfx.py (gf_pow/gf_pow_end/gf_save/gf_reentry, all synthesized).
assets/games/geometry.notes: edges/glow drawn near-white so the THEMES recolor the world by modulate; skins carry their own identity colors and are never theme-tinted; no faces on the square (owner law)

assets/games/chess.provenance: v0.3.8 CHECKMATE: 48 piece pngs (4 sets x 6 pieces x 2 colors), 100% original hand-placed polygon silhouettes by tools/v038_chess_art.py (five symmetric profiles + the one side-view knight). The studied app's wood sheet was never copied - our sets are classic/minimal/bold/royal with the box's own palettes. Re-derive: python3 tools/v038_chess_art.py

assets/audio/sfx (d_* c_* m_solve).provenance: v0.3.8: 21 synthesized sounds by tools/v038_domino_chess_sfx.py (the domino clack family d_*, the chess knock family c_*) + the maze portal-warp solve sound by tools/v038_maze_fix.py (the owner: the old m_win read like the end-of-run jingle - the solve wears its own timbre now, m_win.wav REMOVED). Re-derive: python3 tools/v038_domino_chess_sfx.py && python3 tools/v038_maze_fix.py
